fields.label: Country
fields.note: Select name=CountryTw on the official /Jobs search form.

fields.label: Job category
fields.note: Checkbox group name=REQ_TYPEs_Prefix; repeat the parameter for multiple categories.

fields.label: Experience
fields.note: Select name=WORK_EXP; codes 0=2年以下, 1=3-5年, 2=6-10年, 3=11-15年, 4=16年以上.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Collected from job records; the search form has no employment-type control.

notes: The official airoha.com careers form posts GET to careers.airoha.com/Jobs with fields Keyword, CountryTw, CityTw, WORK_EXP and REQ_TYPEs_Prefix. The keyword query is confirmed: /Jobs returned 10 postings while /Jobs?keyword=engineer returned 2. CityTw is populated dynamically from CountryTw and exposed no options, so cities are not published as values.
